summary: Learning in classical sources is practice, repetition and correction, not merely collecting information.

satellites.title: Learning and Practice
satellites.evidence: Analects 1.1 opens with 學而時習之. Learning is accompanied by repeated practice; the line should not be flattened into rote memorization.

satellites.title: At Fifteen, Set on Learning
satellites.evidence: Analects 2.4: 吾十有五而志于學 — “at fifteen I set my heart on learning”, the first step of the life that runs to 不踰矩 at seventy.
